en.text: Again he began to teach by the seaside. A great multitude was gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat in the sea and sat down. All the multitude were on the land by the sea.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣又在海边教训人。有许多人到他那里聚集，他只得上船坐下。船在海里，众人都靠近海，站在岸上。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌又在海邊教訓人。有許多人到他那裏聚集，他只得上船坐下。船在海裏，眾人都靠近海，站在岸上。

en.text: He taught them many things in parables, and told them in his teaching,

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣就用比喻教训他们许多道理。在教训之间，对他们说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌就用比喻教訓他們許多道理。在教訓之間，對他們說：

en.text: “Listen! Behold, the farmer went out to sow.

zhSimplified.text: 「你们听啊！有一个撒种的出去撒种。

zhTraditional.text: 「你們聽啊！有一個撒種的出去撒種。

en.text: Ashe sowed, some seed fell by the road, and the birds cameand devoured it.

zhSimplified.text: 撒的时候，有落在路旁的，飞鸟来吃尽了；

zhTraditional.text: 撒的時候，有落在路旁的，飛鳥來吃盡了；

en.text: Othersfell on the rocky ground, where it had little soil, and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of soil.

zhSimplified.text: 有落在土浅石头地上的，土既不深，发苗最快，

zhTraditional.text: 有落在土淺石頭地上的，土既不深，發苗最快，

en.text: Whenthe sun had risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.

zhSimplified.text: 日头出来一晒，因为没有根，就枯干了；

zhTraditional.text: 日頭出來一曬，因為沒有根，就枯乾了；

en.text: Othersfell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.

zhSimplified.text: 有落在荆棘里的，荆棘长起来，把它挤住了，就不结实；

zhTraditional.text: 有落在荊棘裏的，荊棘長起來，把它 擠住了，就不結實；

en.text: Othersfell into the good ground and yielded fruit, growing up and increasing. Some produced thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times as much.”

zhSimplified.text: 又有落在好土里的，就发生长大，结实有三十倍的，有六十倍的，有一百倍的」；

zhTraditional.text: 又有落在好土裏的，就發生長大，結實有三十倍的，有六十倍的，有一百倍的」；

en.text: He said, “Whoeverhas ears to hear, let him hear.”
When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.

zhSimplified.text: 无人的时候，跟随耶稣的人和十二个门徒问他这比喻的意思。

zhTraditional.text: 無人的時候，跟隨耶穌的人和十二個門徒問他這比喻的意思。

en.text: He said to them, “Toyou is given the mystery of God’s Kingdom, but to those who are outside, all things are done in parables,

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣对他们说：「 神国的奥秘只叫你们知道，若是对外人讲，凡事就用比喻，

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌對他們說：「上帝國的奧祕只叫你們知道，若是對外人講，凡事就用比喻，

en.text: that‘seeing they may see and not perceive, and hearing they may hear and not understand, lest perhaps they should turn again, and their sins should be forgiven them.’”

zhSimplified.text: 叫他们 看是看见，却不晓得； 听是听见，却不明白； 恐怕他们回转过来，就得赦免。」 （太13·18—23；路8·11—15）

zhTraditional.text: 叫他們 看是看見，卻不曉得； 聽是聽見，卻不明白； 恐怕他們回轉過來，就得赦免。」 （太13‧18－23；路8‧11－15）

en.text: He said to them, “Don’tyou understand this parable? How will you understand all of the parables?

zhSimplified.text: 又对他们说：「你们不明白这比喻吗？这样怎能明白一切的比喻呢？

zhTraditional.text: 又對他們說：「你們不明白這比喻嗎？這樣怎能明白一切的比喻呢？

en.text: Thefarmer sows the word.

zhSimplified.text: 撒种之人所撒的就是道。

zhTraditional.text: 撒種之人所撒的就是道。

en.text: Theones by the road are the ones where the word is sown; and when they have heard, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word which has been sown in them.

zhSimplified.text: 那撒在路旁的，就是人听了道，撒但立刻来，把撒在他心里的道夺了去。

zhTraditional.text: 那撒在路旁的，就是人聽了道，撒但立刻來，把撒在他心裏的道奪了去。

en.text: Thesein the same way are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with joy.

zhSimplified.text: 那撒在石头地上的，就是人听了道，立刻欢喜领受，

zhTraditional.text: 那撒在石頭地上的，就是人聽了道，立刻歡喜領受，

en.text: Theyhave no root in themselves, but are short-lived. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately they stumble.

zhSimplified.text: 但他心里没有根，不过是暂时的，及至为道遭了患难，或是受了逼迫，立刻就跌倒了。

zhTraditional.text: 但他心裏沒有根，不過是暫時的，及至為道遭了患難，或是受了逼迫，立刻就跌倒了。

en.text: Othersare those who are sown among the thorns. These are those who have heard the word,

zhSimplified.text: 还有那撒在荆棘里的，就是人听了道，

zhTraditional.text: 還有那撒在荊棘裏的，就是人聽了道，

en.text: andthe cares of this age, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

zhSimplified.text: 后来有世上的思虑、钱财的迷惑，和别样的私欲进来，把道挤住了，就不能结实。

zhTraditional.text: 後來有世上的思慮、錢財的迷惑，和別樣的私慾進來，把道擠住了，就不能結實。

en.text: Thosewhich were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word, accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times.”

zhSimplified.text: 那撒在好地上的，就是人听道，又领受，并且结实，有三十倍的，有六十倍的，有一百倍的。」 （路8·16—18）

zhTraditional.text: 那撒在好地上的，就是人聽道，又領受，並且結實，有三十倍的，有六十倍的，有一百倍的。」 （路8‧16－18）

en.text: He said to them, “Isa lamp brought to be put under a basket orunder a bed? Isn’t it put on a stand?

footnotes.text: 4:21 literally, a modion, a dry measuring basket containing about a peck (about 9 liters)

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣又对他们说：「人拿灯来，岂是要放在斗底下，床底下，不放在灯台上吗？

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌又對他們說：「人拿燈來，豈是要放在斗底下，床底下，不放在燈臺上嗎？

en.text: Forthere is nothing hidden except that it should be made known, neither was anything made secret but that it should come to light.

zhSimplified.text: 因为掩藏的事，没有不显出来的；隐瞒的事，没有不露出来的。

zhTraditional.text: 因為掩藏的事，沒有不顯出來的；隱瞞的事，沒有不露出來的。

en.text: Ifany man has ears to hear, let him hear.”

zhSimplified.text: 有耳可听的，就应当听！」

zhTraditional.text: 有耳可聽的，就應當聽！」

en.text: He said to them, “Takeheed what you hear. With whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you; and more will be given to you who hear.

zhSimplified.text: 又说：「你们所听的要留心。你们用什么量器量给人，也必用什么量器量给你们，并且要多给你们。

zhTraditional.text: 又說：「你們所聽的要留心。你們用甚麼量器量給人，也必用甚麼量器量給你們，並且要多給你們。

en.text: Forwhoever has, to him more will be given; and he who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.”

zhSimplified.text: 因为有的，还要给他；没有的，连他所有的也要夺去。」

zhTraditional.text: 因為有的，還要給他；沒有的，連他所有的也要奪去。」

en.text: He said, “God’s Kingdom is as if a man should cast seed on the earth,

zhSimplified.text: 又说：「 神的国如同人把种撒在地上。

zhTraditional.text: 又說：「上帝的國如同人把種撒在地上。

en.text: andshould sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, though he doesn’ t know how.

zhSimplified.text: 黑夜睡觉，白日起来，这种就发芽渐长，那人却不晓得如何这样。

zhTraditional.text: 黑夜睡覺，白日起來，這種就發芽漸長，那人卻不曉得如何這樣。

en.text: Forthe earth bears fruit by itself: first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.

zhSimplified.text: 地生五谷是出于自然的：先发苗，后长穗，再后穗上结成饱满的子粒；

zhTraditional.text: 地生五穀是出於自然的：先發苗，後長穗，再後穗上結成飽滿的子粒；

en.text: Butwhen the fruit is ripe, immediately he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.”

zhSimplified.text: 谷既熟了，就用镰刀去割，因为收成的时候到了。」 （太13·31—32；路13·18—19）

zhTraditional.text: 穀既熟了，就用鐮刀去割，因為收成的時候到了。」 （太13‧31－32；路13‧18－19）

en.text: He said, “Howwill we liken God’s Kingdom? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?

zhSimplified.text: 又说：「 神的国，我们可用什么比较呢？可用什么比喻表明呢？

zhTraditional.text: 又說：「上帝的國，我們可用甚麼比較呢？可用甚麼比喻表明呢？

en.text: It’s like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, though it is less than all the seeds that are on the earth,

zhSimplified.text: 好像一粒芥菜种，种在地里的时候，虽比地上的百种都小，

zhTraditional.text: 好像一粒芥菜種，種在地裏的時候，雖比地上的百種都小，

en.text: yetwhen it is sown, grows up and becomes greater than all the herbs, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of the sky can lodge under its shadow.”

zhSimplified.text: 但种上以后，就长起来，比各样的菜都大，又长出大枝来，甚至天上的飞鸟可以宿在它的荫下。」 （太13·34）

zhTraditional.text: 但種上以後，就長起來，比各樣的菜都大，又長出大枝來，甚至天上的飛鳥可以宿在它 的蔭下。」 （太13‧34）

en.text: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣用许多这样的比喻，照他们所能听的，对他们讲道。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌用許多這樣的比喻，照他們所能聽的，對他們講道。

en.text: Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.

zhSimplified.text: 若不用比喻，就不对他们讲；没有人的时候，就把一切的道讲给门徒听。 （太8·23—27；路8·22—25）

zhTraditional.text: 若不用比喻，就不對他們講；沒有人的時候，就把一切的道講給門徒聽。 （太8‧23－27；路8‧22－25）

en.text: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side.”

zhSimplified.text: 当那天晚上，耶稣对门徒说：「我们渡到那边去吧。」

zhTraditional.text: 當那天晚上，耶穌對門徒說：「我們渡到那邊去吧。」

en.text: Leaving the multitude, they took him with them, even as he was, in the boat. Other small boats were also with him.

zhSimplified.text: 门徒离开众人，耶稣仍在船上，他们就把他一同带去；也有别的船和他同行。

zhTraditional.text: 門徒離開眾人，耶穌仍在船上，他們就把他一同帶去；也有別的船和他同行。

en.text: A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.

zhSimplified.text: 忽然起了暴风，波浪打入船内，甚至船要满了水。

zhTraditional.text: 忽然起了暴風，波浪打入船內，甚至船要滿了水。

en.text: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion; and they woke him up and asked him, “Teacher, don’t you care that we are dying?”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣在船尾上，枕着枕头睡觉。门徒叫醒了他，说：「夫子！我们丧命，你不顾吗？」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌在船尾上，枕着枕頭睡覺。門徒叫醒了他，說：「夫子！我們喪命，你不顧嗎？」

en.text: He awoke and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!”The wind ceased and there was a great calm.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣醒了，斥责风，向海说：「住了吧！静了吧！」风就止住，大大地平静了。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌醒了，斥責風，向海說：「住了吧！靜了吧！」風就止住，大大地平靜了。

en.text: He said to them, “Whyare you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣对他们说：「为什么胆怯？你们还没有信心吗？」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌對他們說：「為甚麼膽怯？你們還沒有信心嗎？」

en.text: They were greatly afraid and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

zhSimplified.text: 他们就大大地惧怕，彼此说：「这到底是谁，连风和海也听从他了。」

zhTraditional.text: 他們就大大地懼怕，彼此說：「這到底是誰，連風和海也聽從他了。」
